test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Sam steps out from his house and walks 160 m towards the east. He then takes a right turn and walks 50 m. He then turns right and walks 70 m. He then turns left and walks 35 m. He then turns right and walks 90 m to reach a gift shop. How far and in which direction is the gift shop from Sam's house? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Sam steps out from his house and walks 160 m towards the east.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65a5f5c83dbe6cc1065bdb44a4dee4b8d50739d4d49997b4e93e767319e6a7cd.png] 

2) He then takes a right turn and walks 50 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f8cd9d8e84f6c806fcc1d91bdab81dbc4668dbe1095b6621afd04fe52254098.png] 

3) He then turns right and walks 70 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dd20806c507e521e4c6557147597c665029ae0c2c720e59b003e94562f24016.png] 

4) He then turns left and walks 35 m. He then turns right and walks 90 m to reach a gift shop. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d6f027e33a89cde5df6c181ed6487928c803dfd4b75595956f4b09f872240ff.png] 

Here, we can see that the shop is 85 m, south of the house.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****85 m, South"**.
